About Me

Hi! I’m Amaranth Jin (they/them)! Online, I go by Andrygast.

I’m a Canadian enby who spends most of their either making games or gaming with friends. My top five are Slay the Spire, Noita, Caves of Qud, Satisfactory, and ULTRAKILL.

Besides being chronically on my computer, I love baking, plants, shepherd’s pie, crepe cake, and my favourite colours are amaranth and olive green.

I’m currently developing my first game, SUPERANT, a fast-paced metroidvania where you punch the blood out of monsters on an alien planet. You can read a short decription in THE FIRST ARTICLE.

You can navigate to the All Articles Page for devlogs and tutorials about software, pixel art, and game design.
